_comment: Hand-maintained values the wiki does not have. Each block notes its source. Edit freely; the nightly build merges this over wiki data.

hiveMind._source: community datamine (single source, unverified) via droidtycoonhelper / dubtrackr, v1.36.2

chipCosts._source: droidtycoonhelper droids.json + dubtrackr chip station guide (v1.38). Steps: default→gold, gold→diamond, … stellar→kyber

initialSlots._source: Slots before rebirth 1 = in-game max (11 worker / 9 astromech / 11 battle, confirmed by user 2026-11-11) minus the wiki's rebirth unlocks (7 / 6 / 9, rebirths 1-22).

maxSlots._source: In-game maximum earning slots, confirmed by user 2026-11-11. The build warns if wiki unlocks + initialSlots disagree.

requirementLocations._source: wiki: droids must be in base or lounge. Chip station assumed to count (unverified).
